qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews of the signed candidate 4a2fd76 and serialized fix rechecks of b44f566 found the original scoped-coverage, quiz-safety and comprehensibility defects resolved; correctness was clean from the start. 衣服 restores EN's rule that the word needs no Japanese plural ending, without reproducing the English-translation comparison, and its example now reads «Я сменил мокрую одежду.»; 虫歯 «кариес; кариозный зуб» is guarded against 歯 «зуб; зубы»; and 自慢 gains an unlinked, qualified contrast with 誇り that quotes the existing 誇り card's example. The 作家 pointer to the untranslated occupation-and-role-endings article stays plain text for later restoration; the reviewer withdrew that finding on recheck. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation, the preserved author/reviewer required-versus-conservative exclusion classification and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.
qualifiedVerdicts.fallbackAndVoice: Tag/random fallback options, voice/reading prompts and drawing not cleared.
qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 12 EN exclusions across 11 lists are retained. The reviewed RU title overlaps received 15 direct, one-sided exclusions on 11 new cards: 表情–表現/現れ; 衣服–洋服; 衝突–喧嘩; 衛星–友/連れ/月; 行動–こと; 虫歯–歯; ライター–記者; 菓子–ケーキ/飴; 苦しむ–苦痛; 舌–言葉; 脇–横. One was added after review: 虫歯–歯, a conservative hypernym guard because the RU title adds «кариозный зуб». Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.

scope.navigationNote: Restored 16 relative links across the 10 listed Markdown files at the corresponding EN-linked positions, using EN's href forms. No surrounding prose was changed. Missing kanji cards and unavailable word or article targets remain plain text; no substitute cards were invented.

titleDecisions.declinedOptional: Declined optional items: guarding 舌–言語 (the displayed parentheticals «язык (орган)» and «язык (как система)» disambiguate, and EN has no such pair); guarding 脇–隣 (no overlap requiring a guard; unguarded in EN); and linking 作家's article pointer or importing its examples (the article is untranslated, RU-only links break EN link parity, and the card already states the 作者/作家 rule). The proposed [誇り] link in 自慢 was likewise not added, and the unsupported frequency word «чаще» was dropped. No reviewer finding remains open.
